item.title: Move a neighbourhood repair session indoors
item.context_text: You help at a free event where neighbours bring small broken household items. The rain is starting.
item.objective_text: Move the event indoors and tell booked visitors what they need to know.
success_conditions: Move the event indoors and tell booked visitors what they need to know.

children.title: Read the two booking offers
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Main hall: free at ten, twelve tables, entrance on Oak Street. Small room: free at nine, four tables, entrance by the car park. Eight repairers need one table each.

questions.explanation: Eight repairers can use the twelve tables in the main hall.

questions.prompt: Where is the main hall entrance?

children.title: Hear what the caretaker can do
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I can open the main hall at half past nine, but visitors must wait until ten. Please put a sign on the old outside gate. You can bring tools in through the Oak Street door.

questions.prompt: Who can go in at half past nine?
questions.explanation: The caretaker distinguishes setup from the visitor opening time.

questions.prompt: Where does a sign need to go?
questions.explanation: A sign at the old gate helps arrivals who have not seen the update.

children.title: Brief the first repairer
children.prompt_text: A repairer calls from their car with a bag of tools.
children.instructions: Say when to arrive for setup and which door will be open. Ask for help with one practical job.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Please come to the Oak Street door at half past nine with your tools. Could you help me put a sign on the old outside gate?

points.label: Ask them to help with the sign

children.title: Send the visitors a change notice
children.prompt_text: Write a message for people who booked a repair slot.
children.instructions: Explain why the venue changed, name the entrance, and distinguish setup from public opening. Tell people whether to keep their booking.
children.goal: Move the event indoors and tell booked visitors what they need to know.
children.model_answer: Hello! Because of the rain, tomorrow’s repair session is moving to the main hall. Please enter from Oak Street. We will open the doors to visitors at ten, so keep your booked time if it is ten or later. Look for a sign at the old outside gate.
